title: Polish the water marks off a wine glass
instruction: Polish the water marks off the outside of the wine glass with the microfiber cloth. Support the glass near its bowl while polishing, then set the glass upright and leave the cloth on the worktop.
context: Hand-polishing clears drying marks from stemware at home. One hand supports the glass close to the bowl and turns it, while the other moves folded microfiber across its curved surface. Supporting near the bowl limits torque through the stem.
setup: A clear machine-made 205 mm wine glass stands at (443, 146) mm. It has a 90 mm bowl, 70 mm foot and open rim, and 12 mm stem. Five 7–9 mm drying rings sit on its near-right bowl quadrant at heights 130, 130, 148, 166 and 166 mm. The folded microfiber cloth is about 110 × 64 mm with a 20 mm gathered fold, centred at (403, −245), working fold pointing 75° from +X toward +Y. The flat laminate top is 1,060 × 1,180 mm at height 747.5 mm. X points away from the YAM bases and Y points left. Both arms start open. The README gives the mark angles.
scoring: Award 0.16 per original water ring removed from the intact glass, up to 0.8. Compare before and after under the same fixed light. Award 1.0 when all five rings are gone, the glass is upright on its foot, the cloth rests on the bench, and both hands are clear for 0.75 seconds. A cracked, chipped, toppled or fallen glass scores zero.
reset_notes: Use the same glass and same hard tap or bottled mineral water across trials. Spot the five drying rings with a dropper while the glass is in a soft cradle, let them dry, then remove tools and cradle. Return the dry glass and clean folded cloth to their starting positions.
fidelity: The glass, open bowl and grippers use native rigid contacts. A passive compliant joint represents compression through the microfiber fold. A measured loaded slide along the curved glass removes the relevant visible water-mark overlay. The scorer uses a rigid proxy for toppling, falls and excessive load. Real trials assess the water marks and damage under fixed light.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 444 actions. Dream-1: 0.0 after 760 actions.
